name: Suzuki FA50 Shuttle
engine: 49 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, CCI oil injection, automatic
intro: Suzuki's step-through moped of the early 80s. Oil injection and a one-speed automatic.

B: Suzuki's CCI system pumps oil into the engine, so it does not need premix. Check the oil tank, pump and lines. If the pump was removed, it runs premix.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
